rubric_hint.rule: 4 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: 3.86 ha regeneration felling notification, status notified. Earlier completed fellings (2000 and 2005) overlap only 9.2% of the polygon, so not ALREADY_FELLED.

Four eligible species (VU, site-bound, forest-associated, felling-relevant) are recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, and none within 250 m. These are the beetle Orthotomicus longicollis (263 m, 2019, uncertainty 25 m), Goodyera repens (723 m), Menegazzia terebrata (942 m) and Alectoria sarmentosa (958 m).
The Orthotomicus longicollis record is only 13 m beyond the 250 m ring and has low uncertainty, so it lies close to the HIGH threshold.

Many site-bound forest NT species are recorded within 1000 m (9 in total). The nearest are Crossocalyx hellerianus at 289 m and Hertelidea botryosa at 296 m, so none are within 250 m and the 3-NT criterion is not met.
Effort is adequate: 201 records within 1000 m (county median 129.5). Near-site there is 1 record inside the polygon and 16 records on 5 days within 250 m. The eligible species are not among them.

uncertainties: The records are evidence of recording, not of occupancy of this polygon today.
Orthotomicus longicollis was last recorded in 2019, and the position relative to the polygon edge depends on the reported coordinates.
The one record inside the polygon is not a threatened eligible species in the tool output; its identity is not shown in the results.
not_established: Whether any eligible red-listed species occurs on the notified polygon.
That the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should prioritise this MEDIUM site for stand-level review, especially given the VU beetle at 263 m and the cluster of NT lichens and fungi at 289-462 m. Check for old trees and dead wood on the polygon.
